cohort: The study included 10 pre-uterus transplantation (UTx) women with Mayer-Rokitansky-Kuster-Hauser syndrome (MRKHS) and 7 successful UTx recipients.
finding: Women with MRKHS showed a good response to ovarian stimulation and blastocyst formation, but the success rate per embryo transfer after uterus transplantation was low at 8.8%.
